support_quote: Analyses were conducted according to a per-protocol approach and included participants who completed the 24-week intervention and follow-up assessments. Participants who did not demonstrate adequate adherence to the treatment protocol after randomization were not included in the final analyses.
In the RGBEG, 3 participants were lost to follow-up because of personal reasons and insufficient brace use. The final analyses included 20 participants, with 10 participants in each group.

The MSPPA is a validated 16-item, 5-point Likert-type scale scored from 16 to 80 that measures motivation to participate in physical activity and comprises three subscales: individual reasons, environmental reasons, and amotivation [ 14 ].
